description: 成长内容：词族进化 + 句型迁移

family.example: Be careful when you cross the road.
I can take care of my grandparents.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: care加-ful变成形容词careful（小心的），加-less变成反义词careless（粗心的）。-ful和-less是常见的形容词后缀。
happy变y为i加-ly变成副词happily，加-ness变成名词happiness，加un-前缀变成反义词unhappy。

family.example: I can cook dinner for you.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: cook既作动词也作名词。注意：cooker不是「做饭的人」，而是「炊具」！cook才是厨师。

family.example: My grandpa is ninety years old.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: nine加-th变成序数词ninth（注意去掉e），加-teen变成nineteen（十九），加-ty变成ninety（九十）。

family.example: The birth of the baby made everyone happy.
family.exampleCn: 宝宝的出生让每个人都很开心。

family.example: She gave birth to a baby girl.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: birth + day = birthday（出生的日子=生日），birth + place = birthplace（出生的地方=出生地）。合成词的意思可以从组成部分推导出来。

family.example: I want to spend more time with them.
She spends a lot of time reading.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: spend既可以表示「花时间」也可以表示「花钱」。spend time with sb. 表示「花时间陪伴某人」。

sentencePatterns.pattern: It was + 某人的 + 序数词 + birthday.
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: 表示某人几岁生日，用「物主代词/所有格 + 序数词 + birthday」。66th = sixty-sixth，注意序数词的用法。

transferExamples.english: It was my 12th birthday yesterday.
It was his father's 50th birthday.
Tomorrow will be my grandma's 70th birthday.
transferExamples.chinese: 明天是我奶奶的70岁生日。

transferExamples.english: It was the baby's first birthday.
transferExamples.chinese: 那是宝宝的第一个生日。

sentencePatterns.pattern: 主语 + gave + 间接宾语(人) + 直接宾语(物).
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: His parents gave Grandma a nice smartphone.
sentencePatterns.textbookExampleCn: 他的父母送给奶奶一部漂亮的智能手机。
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: give sb. sth. = give sth. to sb. 这是双宾语结构。间接宾语（人）在前，直接宾语（物）在后。如果直接宾语在前，需要加to。

transferExamples.english: I gave my sister a toy car.
transferExamples.chinese: 我给了我妹妹一辆玩具车。

transferExamples.english: She gave him a book as a gift.
transferExamples.chinese: 她送给他一本书作为礼物。

transferExamples.english: My teacher gave me some advice.
transferExamples.chinese: 我的老师给了我一些建议。

transferExamples.english: Grandma gave me a red envelope.

sentencePatterns.pattern: 主语 + blew out + the candles.
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: blow out 是「吹灭」的意思，blow的过去式是blew（不规则变化）。类似的短语动词还有：blow up（爆炸/充气）, blow away（吹走）。

transferExamples.english: The girl blew out all the candles.
The wind blew out the fire.
Make a wish and blow out the candles.
He blew out the candles in one breath.

sentencePatterns.pattern: 主语 + take/took care of + 宾语.
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: Grandpa and Grandma took care of me.
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: take care of 表示「照顾；照料」，和 look after 意思相近。take的过去式是took。

transferExamples.english: I take care of my little brother.
She took care of her sick mother.
Please take care of my cat when I'm away.
transferExamples.chinese: 我不在的时候请照顾我的猫。

transferExamples.english: We should take care of the elderly.

sentencePatterns.pattern: It is + 节日名称 + today.
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: It is the Double Ninth Festival today.
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: 表达「今天是某个节日」用这个句型。注意：中国传统节日名称前要加the，每个实词首字母大写。

transferExamples.english: It is the Spring Festival today.
It is the Mid-Autumn Festival today.
It is Children's Day today.
It is the Dragon Boat Festival today.

growthExercises.question: 选择正确的词填空：Be ______ when you use the knife. (care)
growthExercises.explanation: 这里需要形容词作表语，careful表示「小心的」，符合句意。

growthExercises.question: 选择正确的词填空：He is a good ______. (cook)
growthExercises.explanation: cook作名词时表示「厨师」，cooker是「炊具」，不能指人。

growthExercises.question: 用所给词造句：yesterday / it / my / 12th / birthday
growthExercises.explanation: 表示昨天是某人的第几个生日，用Yesterday was + 物主代词 + 序数词 + birthday.

growthExercises.question: 翻译：我妈妈给了我一本书。
growthExercises.answer: My mother gave me a book.
growthExercises.explanation: give sb. sth. 给某人某物，双宾语结构。

growthExercises.question: 翻译：我们应该照顾老人。
growthExercises.answer: We should take care of the elderly.
growthExercises.explanation: take care of 照顾；the elderly 老年人。
